mintAuthority.summary: EURS native issuance is reviewed on Ethereum, Algorand, Stellar, and XDC. Ethereum mint, freeze, and delegate administration is controlled by the STASIS 3-of-7 Safe; verified source resolves storage slot 3 as the fee collector, not a control. Algorand uses a fixed 3-of-5 issuer multisig as the ASA manager/reserve/freeze account, XDC uses a 2-of-5 issuer controller, and Stellar uses a 3-of-5 issuer account. Polygon, Arbitrum, and Gnosis are external representations whose bridge controls are assessed only in Bridge Risk.

upgradeability.controlRef: STASIS owner Safe (native mint, freeze, and delegate authority)

controls.label: STASIS owner Safe (native mint, freeze, and delegate authority)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770442, EURSToken storage slot 2 still held this delegate Safe. The current Safe API read returned the listed 3-of-7 owners, no enabled modules, a zero guard, and Safe 1.3.0. Current eth_call simulations of createTokens(0), createTokens(1), freezeTransfers(), and unfreezeTransfers() succeeded from this Safe. The verified token source also exposes Safe-gated setDelegate administration, so this Safe can authorize a replacement issuer and replace native mint logic without an on-chain supply ceiling.

controls.label: Algorand EURS ASA manager/reserve/freeze account
controls.capDescription: ASA 227855942 has the uint64 maximum total. The issuer-controlled account is simultaneously manager, reserve, and freeze authority; the manager can change ASA management fields and the reserve account can issue units up to that maximum.
controls.evidence: At Algorand round 64481636 on 2026-08-27, ASA 227855942 still reported STASIS EURO/EURS, six decimals, a maximum uint64 total, and this same issuer account as manager, reserve, and freeze authority; clawback remained the zero address. The current account record had no auth-addr, so it had not been rekeyed. Its outgoing asset-transfer transaction N7TEJ4JBNH2ATKCGYHGNVDLHA4NOPDAYT66QR5ZNAWO6NBCXXDUA carries an Algorand multisig envelope with version 1, threshold 3, and five fixed public keys, three of which signed. The manager/reserve account is therefore a native 3-of-5 issuer control path.

controls.label: XDC EURS issuer MultiSigWallet controller
controls.evidence: At XDC block 106140914, the EURS token's mint gate was controlled by this deployed MultiSigWallet-style contract. getOwners() returned five owners and required() returned 2. A current eth_call of createTokens(1) returned true with this controller as msg.sender and reverted from unrelated addresses. XDCScan does not present an exact verified source match for the deployed token, but the controller, owner set, and mint call gate are verified from RPC.

controls.label: Stellar issuer account multisig
controls.evidence: At Stellar ledger 63986038, the current Horizon read still showed five active weight-one signers, a weight-zero master key, and low/medium/high thresholds of 3. The account's last-modified ledger was 63395662. This 3-of-5 issuer account can create unbounded Stellar EURS trustline balances; no contract supply cap applies.

review.evidence: The corrected native review covers Ethereum, Algorand, Stellar, and XDC only. At Ethereum block 25770442, Safe 0x1bee4f735062cd00841d6997964f187f5f5f5ac9 remained the 3-of-7 owner/delegate authority: current createTokens and freeze/unfreeze call simulations succeeded from the Safe. The verified EURSToken storage layout places owner after the two inherited mappings at slot 2, feeCollector at slot 3, and delegate later in storage; source gates createTokens, freezeTransfers, and setDelegate on owner. The code-empty slot-3 address is therefore a fee recipient, not a control, and has been removed from the authority inventory. At Algorand round 64481636, ASA 227855942 used the unrekeyed issuer account as manager, reserve, and freeze authority with a maximum uint64 total; an outgoing transaction from that account exposes a fixed 3-of-5 Algorand multisig envelope. At Stellar ledger 63986038, the issuer account retained five weight-one signers and 3-of-5 thresholds. At XDC block 106140914, the 2-of-5 controller 0x527e5b61bc8806059aef098c97fb36db3bc4cc63 passed createTokens(1) and unrelated senders reverted. Polygon, Arbitrum, and Gnosis representation minting and upgrade/admin machinery are excluded from Mint Authority and retained under Bridge Risk. The native set remains economically unbounded, with periodic issuer-operated reconciliation and no verified prudential supervision; STASIS's live transparency page published an assets-and-liabilities statement for 2026-08-07 on 2026-08-08, while current independent assurance was not established.
